metadata.label: Respaldo
metadata.description: The link between a Learning Element and a Learning Outcome, through the course. Since the outcome is canonical per course, a validated backing serves every study plan that includes that course. Has no term. Unique per (learningElementId, courseId, learningOutcomeId). The professor never creates a Backing: it always starts Proposed by an AI agent.

courseId.title: Course
courseId.description: Course where the backing is declared (Activity with recordType Course). Bridge between object and outcome.

learningOutcomeId.title: Learning Outcome
learningOutcomeId.description: Learning outcome backed (CurricularSection with recordType LearningOutcome).

character.title: Character
character.description: Pedagogical role of the object relative to the outcome. Enables the accreditation finding of an outcome backed only by objects that develop, none that evaluate.

offeredCognitiveLevel.title: Offered Cognitive Level
offeredCognitiveLevel.description: Cognitive level the object actually offers for this outcome in this course. Not a copy of the element's general cognitiveLevel; the main metric compares the outcome's required level against this field.

modelConfidence.title: Model Confidence
modelConfidence.description: Confidence (0-1) of the AI model when proposing this backing. Below a threshold (defined in logic/), the backing enters the curator queue as LowConfidenceBacking. This is the AI half of the backing's confidence; the professor half is not stored here, it is derived from whether a BackingJudgment with decision=Confirm exists for this backing.

status.title: Status
status.description: Validated requires prior usage of the object in that course, enforced by the transition guard: the Proposed -> Validated transition carries the condition proposedWithoutUsage == false (F2). The way back exists because FLOW-08 raises a Conflict task when a professor reconsiders a judgement on a backing that may already be validated, and F4 lets the curator decide the status directly. Both moves require mod/learning-catalog:task.resolve, the capability of completing a curator flow, which is a different thing from being allowed to edit the field.

transitions.message: No se puede validar un respaldo propuesto sin uso previo del elemento en ese curso: primero tiene que existir el Uso.

proposedWithoutUsage.title: Proposed Without Usage
proposedWithoutUsage.description: Whether the backing was born without prior usage of the element in this course (detected by semantic similarity). Only applies while status=Proposed; never true on a validated backing.

validatedById.title: Validated By
validatedById.description: Curator (core_User id) who validated the backing.
